parts.title: Vocabulary
parts.instr: Write the word from the box beside its meaning. Each word is used once. Cross out each word as you use it.
parts.bankNote: describe · sound · kitchen · adjective · see · taste · smell

example.text: the room where a family cooks is a

items.text: what your nose notices is a
to notice something with your eyes is to
to try food to know its flavour is to
what your ears hear is a
to say what something is like is to
the name for a describing word like soft or bright:

parts.how: Word box: describe · sound · kitchen · adjective · see · taste · smell. Outcome W7. Check each answer as it appears.

parts.title: am, is or are
parts.instr: Write am, is or are on each line. You can use a word more than once.
parts.how: Word box: are · am · is. Outcome W9. Check each answer as it appears.

parts.title: a, an or the
parts.instr: Write a, an or the on each line.

example.text: There is ( ? ) bag on the chair.

items.text: ( ? ) radio in the kitchen is old.
There is ( ? ) egg in the pan.

parts.how: Word box: the · a · an. Outcome W11. Check each answer as it appears.

parts.title: Place words
parts.instr: Write a place word on each line. Use the box.
parts.how: Word box: on · beside · in · under. Outcome W11. Check each answer as it appears.

parts.title: and, but or so
parts.instr: Write and, but or so on the line.

items.text: I was cold, ( ? ) I closed the window.
I like tea, ( ? ) I do not like coffee.
The bus was late, ( ? ) I walked.

parts.how: Word box: but · so · and. Outcome W2. Check each answer as it appears.

parts.title: Capitals and end marks
parts.instr: Add the capital letters and the end mark. Write the whole sentence again.
parts.how: Outcome W5. Write the whole sentence again, fixed.

parts.title: Sentence or fragment?
parts.instr: Write S for a complete sentence or F for a fragment.

items.text: The cold window in the morning.

parts.how: Outcome W1. Check each answer as it appears.

parts.title: Sentence or fragment?
parts.instr: Fix two fragments. Rewrite each one as a complete sentence.

example.ans: The rice crackles in the pan.

items.ans: Any complete sentence, e.g. I get on when the bus comes.

items.text: The cold window in the morning.  →
items.ans: Any complete sentence, e.g. The window is cold in the morning.

parts.how: Outcome W1. Write the whole sentence again, fixed.

parts.title: Joining ideas
parts.instr: Write and, but, so or because on the line.

items.text: I stay home ( ? ) I am sick.
It was cold, ( ? ) I wore a coat.
The soup is hot, ( ? ) it is not spicy.

parts.how: Word box: so · because · but · and. Outcome W2. Check each answer as it appears.

parts.title: Joining ideas
parts.instr: Join the pair into ONE sentence. Comma before but and so, never before because. (2 marks.)

example.text: The window is cold. It is sunny outside.  →
example.ans: The window is cold, but it is sunny outside.

items.text: The kitchen smells good. Grandmother is cooking.  →
items.ans: The kitchen smells good because Grandmother is cooking.

parts.how: Outcome W2. Write the whole sentence again, fixed.

parts.title: Capitals and openings
parts.instr: Write each sentence again with the correct capital letters.

example.text: my friend lina is from manila.  →
example.ans: My friend Lina is from Manila.

items.text: on friday i go to the library.  →
items.ans: On Friday I go to the library.

parts.how: Outcome W7. Write the whole sentence again, fixed.

parts.title: Capitals and openings
parts.instr: Rewrite each sentence so it starts differently. Put a comma after the opening. (2 marks each.)

example.text: The rain taps on the glass.  →
example.ans: Outside, the rain taps on the glass.

items.ans: Any opening + comma, e.g. In the morning, the bus comes at eight.

items.text: I do my homework after dinner.  →
items.ans: After dinner, I do my homework.

parts.how: Outcome W7. Write the whole sentence again, fixed.

parts.title: Edit the paragraph
parts.instr: This paragraph has SIX mistakes. Write it again with every mistake fixed.

items.ans: join: …some fish because they need dinner.

parts.how: Six mistakes: a capital, a comma, two verbs, a fragment and an end mark. The example shows a trap: an onion is already correct.

musts: Use a place word in every sentence.
Join two ideas with and, but or so in ONE sentence.
Use an adjective in every sentence.
Capital letter at the start, end mark at the end.
pb1.task: Write THREE sentences about your bedroom.
pb1.note: Practice: 3 marks each for W1, W2, W5 and W7 (Not Yet 0 · Minimally 1 · Meeting 2 · Fully 3). Not entered in the gradebook.

musts: Beginning: name the room and say one thing about it.
Middle: three details — where things are and a sense detail.
End: say what the room is like for you.
Use because once and but or so once. No fragments.
pb2.task: Write a short paragraph (at least FIVE sentences) about your bedroom.
pb2.note: Practice: 4 marks each for W3, W1, W2 and W7 (Not Yet 1 · Minimally 2 · Meeting 3 · Fully 4). Not entered in the gradebook.

para: on Saturday, Lina goes to the market with her grandmother. The market is busy but it is fun. Grandmother buy an onion and some fish. Because they need dinner. Lina carry the bags
